stv_literature: No STV study reports translation or ribosome changes (Fukuhara et al. 2020 abstract; Badeli et al. 2026 preprint; Elvira-Gonzalez et al. 2020).
tomato_virus_literature: Acute infections: TSWV in tomato down-regulated protein biosynthesis (Prigigallo et al. 2025); begomovirus-triggered NIK1-LIMYB repression of translational machinery genes in Arabidopsis (Zorzatto et al. 2015).
literature_relation_category: not directly comparable (acute viruses; opposite direction where reported)
interpretation: Ribosome, ribosome-biogenesis and translation sets rank higher in STV-infected leaves (coordinated rank-level shift; no gene individually significant). The pattern did not survive correlation-aware validation, no set is broadly replicate-consistent, and most sets lose support when STV_infected_rep1 is removed. Not a defensible STV-associated signal in this dataset.
caveats: Transcript ranking is not ribosome abundance or protein synthesis. Dependence on one infected replicate. Strong inter-gene correlation in these sets (high CAMERA VIF). Acute-virus literature not comparable.

stv_literature: No STV claim on photosynthesis genes; no symptoms or leaf cell ultrastructural changes in STV-infected tomato (Elvira-Gonzalez et al. 2020).
tomato_virus_literature: Acute infections repress photosynthesis genes in tomato: PepMV (Hanssen et al. 2011), TYLCTHV (He et al. 2024), TSWV (Prigigallo et al. 2025); ToCV reduces chloroplast lamellae (Yue et al. 2024).
literature_relation_category: not directly comparable (acute viruses; opposite direction)
interpretation: Plastid, thylakoid and photosynthesis sets rank higher in STV-infected leaves; most sets are broadly replicate-consistent; no set is ch00-sensitive and organelle-identical features are about 1 % of leading-edge slots. The directional tendency persists conceptually after the ch00 caveat, but it is fgsea-only and no gene is individually significant: exploratory.
caveats: Did not survive correlation-aware validation. Transcript level is not photosynthetic activity. Several sets depend on a single sample in LOO (maximum 32 %, STV_free_rep2). Opposite to the repression reported for acute viruses; not comparable.

tomato_virus_literature: TYLCTHV disrupted F-type ATPase gene expression in tomato (He et al. 2024; acute).
literature_relation_category: not directly comparable (acute virus); technical caveat dominates
interpretation: The positive shift is carried largely by the organelle-identical feature class: these features fill 29 % of leading-edge slots and 4 of 5 sets lose significance without them under both exclusion rules. The theme is sensitive to reference and feature composition and is not used as evidence of an STV-associated nuclear response.
caveats: Sequence identity is not genomic origin. SL4.0ch00 contains complete plastome and mitogenome sequence; poly(A)-selected library. Owner decision D-044: no re-quantification and no further exclusion analysis.

stv_literature: Badeli et al. 2026 (preprint): PR-protein locus and 'response to fungus' lower in STV-infected, not significant. Elvira-Gonzalez et al. 2020: STV-responsive miRNAs predicted to target stress/defence genes (prediction only); few STV vsiRNAs.
tomato_virus_literature: Acute infections induce defence genes in tomato: ToBRFV (Wang et al. 2024), TYLCTHV (He et al. 2024), TSWV (Prigigallo et al. 2025), TYLCV (Romero-Rodriguez et al. 2023), PepMV via SA (Hanssen et al. 2011); Arabidopsis (Whitham et al. 2003).
literature_relation_category: same direction as STV preprint trend (n.s.); opposite to acute-virus induction (not comparable)
interpretation: Defence-response sets rank lower in STV-infected leaves, and 7 of 8 are broadly replicate-consistent. Leading-edge genes include allene oxide cyclase, NB-ARC and EIX-receptor genes and chitinases; none is individually significant (minimum padj 0.193). This is a directional tendency, consistent in direction with the non-significant trend reported by Badeli et al.: exploratory.
caveats: Did not survive correlation-aware validation. 4 of 8 sets depend on STV_free_rep2 in LOO (boundary of the U2 rule). Leading edges overlap the hormone and water/abiotic themes, so these are not independent signals.

stv_literature: Fukuhara et al. 2020 (abstract): genes of ethylene biosynthesis and signalling down-regulated in STV-infected M82. Badeli et al. 2026 (preprint): ACO1 lower in STV-infected, padj 0.225; no gene at FDR < 0.05.
tomato_virus_literature: Hormone pathway changes are common in acute infections (e.g. SA signalling with PepMV, Hanssen et al. 2011); not specific to ethylene.
literature_relation_category: same direction as both STV studies (gene level not significant in reanalyses)
interpretation: Ethylene-related sets rank lower in STV-infected leaves, and 4 of 5 are broadly replicate-consistent. The direction is the same as in both STV studies. At gene level, ACO1 is lower in all 9 infected-free pairs but padj is 0.297, and no gene is significant. This is an exploratory directional pattern; ethylene signalling is not shown to be significantly altered.
caveats: Did not survive correlation-aware validation; 1 of 5 sets is Tier 4. The theme regex contains 'ethylene' (disclosed). 'Ethylene biosynthetic process' could not be tested (4 genes). Overlaps the defence leading edges (20 shared genes).

tomato_virus_literature: ToBRFV DEGs enriched in protein folding (Wang et al. 2024); ER stress / UPR induction by acute viruses is reported but was not reviewed in depth here.
literature_relation_category: not directly comparable (acute viruses; opposite direction)
interpretation: The four ER component sets rank lower in STV-infected leaves, but all four lose support when STV_free_rep1 is removed and only one is broadly replicate-consistent. The top leading-edge genes are sterol and phospholipid biosynthesis enzymes rather than folding chaperones. Not a defensible STV-associated signal: unsupported.
caveats: STV_free_rep1 is the documented outlier sample (Phase 5, D-022) and is kept in all primary analyses; this classification does not remove it. fgsea-only.

tomato_virus_literature: Oxidoreductase families up-regulated in TSWV-infected tomato (Prigigallo et al. 2025). Persistent bean endornavirus: oxidation-reduction is the most frequent GO category among 132 DEGs (Khankhum et al. 2016; data paper, not an enrichment test).
interpretation: Heme-binding, monooxygenase and tetrapyrrole sets shift in both directions (5 up, 6 down), with cytochrome P450 genes prominent among negative leading edges. Most sets are broadly replicate-consistent, but the theme has no coherent direction: exploratory and largely GO-redundant.
caveats: Mixed direction. 4 of 11 sets depend on STV_free_rep1 in LOO. 1 set is ch00-sensitive. fgsea-only.

tomato_virus_literature: Khankhum et al. 2016 (persistent endornavirus, bean; descriptive GO distribution).
interpretation: Glutathione sets rank lower in STV-infected leaves, with leading edges dominated by glutathione S-transferases; 3 of 3 are broadly replicate-consistent. A small exploratory theme that overlaps the water/abiotic and heme themes.
caveats: fgsea-only. Small theme (3 sets). Leading-edge overlap with other stress themes (Jaccard 0.13 - 0.17).

stv_literature: Elvira-Gonzalez et al. 2020: miRNA targets predicted in stress-response pathways (prediction only).
tomato_virus_literature: ToBRFV DEGs in response to stress and wounding (Wang et al. 2024; acute).
interpretation: Water-deprivation, abiotic-stimulus and oxidative-stress sets rank lower in STV-infected leaves, with WRKY transcription factors and catalase in the leading edges; 3 of 3 are broadly replicate-consistent. Exploratory and not independent of the defence and glutathione signals.
caveats: fgsea-only. Small theme (3 sets). Overlaps the glutathione and defence leading edges.

stv_literature: Badeli et al. 2026 (preprint): beta-galactosidase and PGIP loci in its Table 2 (not significant).
interpretation: Carbohydrate-binding and cell-wall sets shift in both directions (2 up, 2 down), with wall-associated and receptor kinases in the negative leading edges. No coherent direction: exploratory.
caveats: Mixed direction. 2 of 4 sets depend on STV_free_rep2 in LOO (boundary of the U2 rule). 1 set is ch00-sensitive. fgsea-only.
